motion_codec_switch.source: Local MediaMTX 1.21.1; FFmpeg 9.0.2 testsrc2 publishers for H.264 peer, H.264 motion camera, and H.265 motion camera; each 320x180 at 15 fps over TCP RTSP
motion_codec_switch.client: Actual eufy-wall Mac binary, 640x180 window, software decode, two 16x32 cells on a 32x32 canvas: fixed H.264 URL peer and motion: latest watching CAM264/CAM265
motion_codec_switch.bridge: Isolated local WebSocket stub sent hello with stream keys/codecs and motion events CAM264, CAM265, CAM264; MediaMTX logged a TCP reader for the H.265 track

deliberate_compositor_stop_and_recreate.sources: two local synthetic videotestsrc live tiles
deliberate_compositor_stop_and_recreate.injection: set only the test compositor pipeline to NULL after both tiles decode; wait for fatal output-freeze error, close it, then construct a new renderer

limits: The window output counter is upstream of the macOS display sink; pixels and displayed drops were not measured.
The codec-switch observation is one bounded local synthetic trial, not a long soak or a real Eufy motion event.
The output-freeze trial uses a headless sink and synthetic sources; it verifies native detection, cleanup, and recreation, not launchd restart or a physical window after a compositor failure.
Neither trial covers sleep/wake, Apple Silicon, or a clean-host installer.
